lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お母さん、本当、絵、描いた。
lines.en: Mom, I really did draw a picture!
lines.style: Bright, proud announcement. Quick opening attack on the first word. High, genuine childish voice throughout. Soft audible excitement — not performing, just truly happy to share. Warmth woven through naturally.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: わあ、本当、可愛い、本当に。
lines.en: Oh, that's so cute — truly lovely!
lines.style: Warm maternal intake of breath. Genuine delight, unhurried. Soft repetition on 'truly' — savoring the moment. Tender attention in every syllable. No performance, just real presence.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I'm so happy we did it together!
lines.style: High, open-hearted excitement. Leans into the togetherness. Quick, genuine childish tone without affectation. Small pause before the end — letting the warmth linger. Voice carries uncomplicated joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 優しい、ひなちゃん、本当に。
lines.style: Maternal voice, soft and steady. The name spoken with particular tenderness. Slight emphasis on 'really' — acknowledging something true she's noticing in her daughter. No rush. Depth underneath the gentleness.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: That picture was so much fun!
lines.style: Child's voice, warm and contented. The closing statement of someone at ease. Gentle, thoughtful quality — not winding down but settling into quiet satisfaction. Small trailing breath at the end.
